lora_unverified_trajectory.train_command:
python experiments/distiller/train_lora.py --arm lora_unverified_trajectory --base-model-id Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B --dataset /home/user/workspaces/jaewon/myworld/experiments/distiller/data/train_lora_unverified_trajectory.jsonl --output /home/user/workspaces/jaewon/myworld/experiments/distiller/data/lora_lora_unverified_trajectory --epochs 3 --sentinel-fraction 0.15 --early-stopping-patience 2
